name: Wade's extruder to bowden cable, for every hole

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a cylindrical Bowden adapter mount designed for 3D printer hotends. It features a solid cylindrical base with a central vertical hole running through its entire height. The upper portion of the cylinder has flat cutouts on opposite sides to create parallel mounting faces, along with a narrow slot cut through one side to allow for clamping or alignment.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric Bowden adapter mount in OpenSCAD. The model should consist of a main cylinder with a customizable diameter and height, a central hole for the Bowden tube, and flat side cutouts along with a vertical slot to facilitate mounting.
captions.factory: The model is built using a boolean difference operation. A main outer cylinder (representing the hotend mount diameter and height) is first created. From this, a smaller concentric cylinder is subtracted to form the central Bowden cable path. Finally, three rectangular cubes are translated and subtracted from the upper section to create the flat mounting faces and the vertical slot.
